description:
About the role

For more than 60 years, Complex has been known for delivering award winning construction projects across the built environment.


Our skillful execution of quality projects is an expression of our personal and professional commitment to connecting and enhancing communities.


We are looking for a Lead Estimator, this role will provide support and technical advice to our estimating team, deliver accurate, competitive, and well-documented cost estimates for civil & construction projects, while also providing oversight and tender coordination to the estimating team.


The Lead Estimator is a critical role that remains hands-on in the preparation of tenders while contributing to pricing strategy, subcontractor engagement, and achieving tendering milestones.


Key responsibilities

  • Prepare accurate and competitive cost estimates, budgets, and scopes of work for civil construction tenders

  • Perform and review quantity take-offs using Benchmark, Revu, and Excel
  • Prepare detailed cost build-ups, subcontractor comparisons, and pricing reconciliations
  • Analyse historical project data to support pricing accuracy and continuous improvement
  • Promote consistent estimating methodologies, tools, and documentation standards
  • Maintain effective working relationships with key subcontractors and suppliers

About you

  • Minimum 5 years' experience in commercial construction / civil infrastructure estimating
  • Demonstrated experience preparing and leading complex civil tenders
  • Strong understanding of civil, building and construction methodologies, contract review and risk identification, and cost planning and pricing strategy
  • Proven ability to mentor and support junior and mid-level estimators
  • High-level competency in Benchmark, Bluebeam Revu, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft Project (Intermediate level)
  • Ability to manage multiple tenders and competing deadlines

description:

Description

Job Summary:

The BESS Project Scheduler is responsible for developing, maintaining, and analyzing detailed project schedules for Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects. This role plays a critical part in ensuring projects are delivered on time by providing accurate schedule forecasts, identifying risks, and supporting project teams with data-driven insights across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and energization phases. This role requires a strong leader that will take ownership of driving accurate and up to date scheduling across multiple projects as well as taking initiative to drive process improvements where there is an opportunity to improve.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain integrated project schedules for BESS projects from NTP through COD
  • Build schedules covering engineering, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, civil, electrical, installation, commissioning, and grid interconnection
  • Collaborate with Project Managers, Construction Managers, OEMs, and subcontractors to validate logic, durations, and sequencing
  • Perform critical path analysis, float analysis, and schedule risk assessments
  • Track project progress and update schedules using actuals, forecasts, and recovery plans
  • Identify schedule impacts related to procurement delays, permitting, weather, interconnection, or change orders
  • Prepare schedule narratives, look-ahead schedules, and progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Support claims, change management, and time-impact analyses as required
  • Ensure schedules align with contract milestones, EPC agreements, and owner requirements
  • Maintain schedule standards, templates, and best practices across the portfolio
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements

  • Bachelorâs degree in construction management, Engineering, Project Management, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 5+ years of project scheduling experience in utility-scale energy, power generation, or heavy civil construction
  • Direct experience supporting BESS, solar, wind, or substation projects
  • Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 (required)
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Project and Excel
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, procurement lead times, and commissioning activities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with EPC contracts and utility-scale energy storage projects
  • Knowledge of battery OEM workflows (manufacturing, FAT, shipping, commissioning)
  • Familiarity with Power BI or other reporting/analytics tools
  • Experience supporting schedule recovery plans and delay analysis
  • Experience developing resource-loaded and cost-loaded schedules
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present schedule data clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Work Environment/Physical Requirements

  • Combination of office, remote, and active construction site environments

description:
Civils Estimator

  • Job Type: Full-time


Reed Recruitment are delighted to be recruiting for one of the UKâs leading multi-discipline Civil Engineering and Building contractors, for a Civils Estimator. This role offers a fantastic opportunity for career development and progression within a dynamic team.


Day-to-day of the role:

  • Provide a comprehensive estimating service, controlling either an assigned project or a portfolio of projects.
  • Identify potential risks from initial analysis of project documentation.
  • Prepare tender estimates from first principles using Conquest estimating software, drawing on previous experience and knowledge of techniques, outputs, subcontractor quotations, and material prices unique to each tender.

  • Obtain feedback from site teams on estimating adequacy and current costs.


Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • HND/C in Civil Engineering.
  • At least two years of previous experience working in an Estimating Department.
  • Thorough understanding of construction techniques, outputs, and the relationship between costs from these and the market values and how this is utilised in tendering.

  • High level of PC literacy with working knowledge of Conquest Series Q, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word & Project software.


Desirable:

  • CSCS Card.
  • Eagerness to learn from experienced members of the company to further understanding.
  • Knowledge and experience of CESMM, SMM Methods of Measurement, production of activity schedules, and population of contract sum analyses.
  • Ability to work independently utilising several standard forms of contract such as NEC/JCT and bespoke contracts.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Long-term career opportunities and excellent potential for future development and progression.
  • Opportunity to work with a leading company in the industry.

title: Senior Specialist Global QMS
description:
More than one million people in the United States today are fighting blood cancer. While a traditional allogeneic stem cell transplant has been the best hope for many, the transplant itself can prove fatal or lead to serious conditions, such as graft vs. host disease. Orca Bio is a commercial-stage biotechnology company redefining the transplant process by developing next-generation cell therapies with the goal of providing significantly better survival rates with dramatically fewer risks. With our purified, high-precision cell therapies we hope to not only replace patients' blood and immune systems with healthy ones, but also restore their lives.


The Senior Specialist, Global QMS will help implement Orca Bioâs global quality management system across all sites. This role will support and lead the internal audit program, supplier management program, and inspection readiness. This role will support the growth and expansion of the global quality program to support manufacturing of our cell therapy products. You will help establish, implement and maintain the audit program across Orca Bio sites to ensure compliance with GxP and regulatory expectations. Your role will support Orca Bios commercial readiness and ongoing clinical programs by managing and facilitating audits, resolving supplier-related quality issues and interacting with quality management teams at the site levels to ensure consistent application of quality systems across the organization.

\n


Responsibilities:
  • Plan, schedule and execute internal audits across all sites and functions in accordance with the internal audit program.
  • Develop audit agenda, conduct interviews, review processes and generate audit reports.
  • Support the global Quality Management Review (QMR) process, ensuring timely data collection, analysis, and reporting to senior leadership.
  • Support the supplier qualification and management program, including risk assessments, supplier audits, and ongoing monitoring to ensure compliance with GxP requirements.
  • Drive global inspection management activities, ensuring cross-functional and site readiness for FDA, EMA, and other health authority inspections.
  • Provide oversight and guidance to site QMR administrators ensuring consistent quality system implementation across all Orca Bio sites.
  • Establish and monitor global QMS key performance indicators (KPIs), oversee trending of quality metrics, and ensure data-driven insights are used to improve quality systems and performance.
  • Partner with IT and business process owners to identify and implement QMS system enhancements, including defining requirements, driving prioritization and ensuring changes are validated and compliant.
  • Review, approve, and provide quality oversight for validation documentation (e.g., equipment qualification, computer system validation, process validation) for global enterprise systems (e.g. MasterControl, ERP systems, Trackwise, etc.) ensuring alignment with regulatory and internal requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional and site leadership teams to drive continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring the QMS evolves in line with business needs and regulatory expectations.


Experience:
  • Bachelorâs degree in a scientific or engineering discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum 5+ years of relevant Quality Assurance or Quality Systems experience in a GxP-regulated environment, with at least 2-3 years in a leadership role.
  • Strong knowledge of global quality regulations and standards (FDA, EMA, ICH, ISO 9001, 21 CFR Parts 210/211/820, EU GMP).
  • Proven experience leading Quality Management Review, internal audit programs, supplier management processes, and validation oversight.
  • Demonstrated success in establishing and trending quality performance metrics and KPIs.
  • Experience supporting and/or administering electronic QMS systems and partnering with IT for system enhancements.
  • Experience working in a multi-site or global quality organization strongly preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across functional and site boundaries.


\n
$90,000 - $120,000 a year
\n

The anticipated annual salary range for this job is based on prior experience in the role/industry, education, location, internal equity, and other job-related factors as permitted by law. For remote-based positions, this range may vary based on your local market. Full-time employment positions will also be eligible to receive pre-IPO equity and annual bonus, in addition to competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, PTO, 401(k) plan, life and accidental death and disability coverage, and parental leave benefits. Other perks include subsidized daily lunches and snacks at our on-site locations.

 

Who we are

 

We are driven by a passion for science and compassion for patients. We act with urgency to ensure our treatments are one day accessible to all who need them.

 

We live by our core values of passion, courage, and integrity. Excellence in our work means the chance to unlock a better quality of life for our patients, and with that comes tremendous responsibility.

 

We innovate on a path that hasnât been paved. We embrace an entrepreneurial spirit and take calculated risks to achieve our mission. We arenât afraid to ask âwhy notâ and challenge the status quo.

 

We maintain a start-up culture of camaraderie and leadership by example, regardless of title.

 

Weâre proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and recognize that celebrating our differences creates stronger, lasting solutions that better serve our team, our patients and their healthcare providers.

 

Notice to staffing firms

 

Orca Bio does not accept resumes from staffing agencies with which we do not have a written agreement and specific engagement for a particular opening. Our employment activities, inquiries and offers are managed through our HR/Talent team, and all candidates are presented through this channel only. Quantity Surveyor / QS Engineer â Civil Construction

Project: Commercial Hotel Construction Project

Location: Vijayawada / Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh

Site: Daspalla Project Site

Experience: 5+ Years

Employment Type: Full-time, Site-based

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Quantity Surveyor / QS Engineer with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in civil/building construction to join the project team for a commercial hotel construction project in Vijayawada/Amaravati.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in quantity estimation, BOQ preparation, rate analysis, measurement, subcontractor billing, client billing, material reconciliation and cost control.

Candidates with experience in commercial buildings, hotels, high-rise buildings or large-scale building projects will be preferred.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and review BOQs, quantity take-offs and estimates for civil and finishing works.
  • Prepare detailed quantity calculations from architectural, structural and MEP drawings.
  • Conduct regular site measurements and maintain accurate measurement records.
  • Prepare and verify contractor/subcontractor bills based on actual site measurements.
  • Review subcontractor RA bills, work orders, measurements and supporting documents.
  • Prepare client bills / RA bills and ensure timely submission.
  • Carry out rate analysis for various civil, structural and finishing items.
  • Monitor project quantities against the BOQ and identify variations.
  • Prepare and maintain variation statements, extra items and deviation statements.
  • Track project costs and assist in maintaining effective cost control.
  • Reconcile quantities of key materials such as cement, steel, concrete and other construction materials.
  • Coordinate with the Project Manager, Site Engineers, Planning Team, Purchase Team, Accounts Team and subcontractors.
  • Check drawings and specifications to identify quantity/cost implications before execution.
  • Maintain proper documentation of measurements, bills, work orders, quotations and quantity records.
  • Assist in preparing project cost forecasts and quantity/progress reports.
  • Support commercial negotiations with subcontractors and vendors when required.
  • Ensure that all billing and measurement documentation is accurate and submitted within project timelines.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Quantity Surveyor / QS Engineer in civil/building construction.
  • Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering or equivalent qualification.
  • Strong knowledge of BOQ preparation, quantity take-off, measurements and billing.
  • Good understanding of civil construction drawings and specifications.
  • Experience in subcontractor billing and client billing.
  • Strong knowledge of rate analysis and cost estimation.
  • Experience handling variation orders, extra items and reconciliation statements.
  • Good knowledge of Excel and quantity/billing-related software.
  • Ability to independently handle QS activities at a project site.
  • Strong analytical and numerical skills.
  • Good coordination and communication skills.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Candidates with experience in the following types of projects will be preferred:

  • Hotels / Hospitality Projects
  • Commercial Buildings
  • High-rise Buildings
  • Residential & Commercial Complexes
  • Large-scale Civil Construction Projects

title: Senior Governance Risk and Compliance Analyst
description:
RainFocus, one of the most innovative software companies, is in search of an exceptional Senior Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) Analyst. 

 

About RainFocus

 

RainFocus cares about its employees, customers, and the world in which we live. Our rapidly growing team serves Fortune 500 companies like Adobe, Cisco, IBM, Oracle, VMware, and others to prepare and execute in-person, virtual, and hybrid events across the world. Those events are delivered through our industry-disrupting software platform, with groundbreaking business intelligence, to elevate the attendee experience, streamline event operations, and accelerate marketing results. We are well-funded, growing fast, and building a company that is changing the market â it will be challenging, fun, and exciting.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior GRC Analyst to join our Security and Privacy team. In this role, you will own and grow RainFocus's governance, risk, and compliance program â maintaining our control framework, leading risk assessments, supporting audits, and driving the program's maturity forward rather than simply maintaining the status quo. You will report directly to the CISO and have significant ownership from day one.

\n


Key Responsibilities:
Lead RainFocus's GRC program across SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and other client/regulatory compliance frameworks, including audit prep, evidence collection, and auditor relationships.
 
Manage and mature our control framework, mapping new regulations and conducting gap assessments.
 
Own the annual security risk assessment process (NIST SP 800-30 methodology), including stakeholder interviews, risk scoring, and residual risk tracking.
 
Maintain and update security policies, standards, and documentation to ensure compliance with industry best practices.
 
Partner with Engineering and Security to mature vulnerability management and secrets-scanning practices, moving these from reactive to proactive, pre-deployment controls.
 
Help build out and operationalize a Data Loss Prevention (DLP) program, including policy design and rollout across email, endpoint, and cloud storage.
 
Grow and mature RainFocus's security awareness training program.
 
Drive AI governance efforts â policy, tooling, and monitoring for approved vs. unapproved AI tool usage across the company.
 
Identify and help close Shadow IT / unmanaged SaaS visibility gaps in partnership with IT.
 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement risk management practices and ensure compliance across the organization.
 
Respond to security and privacy inquiries from clients, partners, and employees.
 
Prepare and present reports on the organization's security and privacy compliance status, including program maturity and remediation progress.
Stay abreast of emerging security threats, vulnerabilities, and compliance requirements.


Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field is highly desirable.

6+ years of proven experience in GRC, IT audit, information security compliance, or a related field.

In-depth knowledge of relevant regulations, standards, and frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, NIST 800-series, GDPR, and others).

Experience running or contributing heavily to formal risk assessments â not just tracking a compliance checklist.

Professional certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISSP, CIPP, or CIPM are highly desirable.

Familiarity with modern security tooling such as Drata, OneTrust, Vanta, etc.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Experience with cloud security and compliance frameworks is a plus.

Experience with OneTrust or related GRC technologies is a plus.


Personal Characteristics:

Strong work ethic and commitment to excellence.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Ability to adapt to change and learn quickly.

Passion for security and privacy.


\n

Why work at RainFocus?

 

At RainFocus we delight millions of attendees at large-scale events by delivering better insights, experiences, and marketing. We were able to pivot our product and services offering in 2020 to continue growing and serving new clients and events.

 

As a member of the RainFocus team, you will have the opportunity to experience first-hand the impact of our platform at events around the world. Additionally, RainFocus offers competitive salaries, competitive benefits, 401k, generous PTO, and countless other team building activities. 

 

What are you waiting for? Apply today! We need more talented, hard-working, fun-loving team members just like yourself!

title: Estimator Brisbane
description:
About McNab

McNab is one of the largest Construction, Development and Property groups in Australia, with turnover now exceeding $1bn each year. Despite our growth and size, we've never lost our small company DNA - which centres around genuine care for our staff, customers and all our stakeholders. Success for us isn't about awards or growth, it's when we deliver so well that our customers are proud to wear a McNab T-Shirt on weekends!


About the Role

Due to growth our Brisbane team is seeking an Estimator who will support the preparation of cost plans, tenders and pricing for repeat work, ECI opportunities and hard dollar tenders. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on estimating work, working with project teams and helping deliver accurate, competitive submissions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare cost plans, tenders and pricing submissions
  • Support repeat work, ECI and hard dollar tender opportunities
  • Work with project teams and stakeholders to gather information and prepare submissions
  • Review drawings, specifications and project requirements
  • Identify risks, gaps and commercial opportunities during the estimating process
  • Prepare subcontractor packages and bill of quantities
  • Liaise with subcontractors and suppliers to obtain pricing
  • Maintain up-to-date market rates and pricing information
  • Contribute to the preparation of bids across multi-residential, retail and industrial projects
  • Use estimating software such as CostX to support accurate pricing and measurement


About You

  • Proven estimating experience in multi-residential, retail and / or industrial projects
  • Commercially aware with strong attention to detail
  • Confident preparing cost plans, tenders and pricing
  • Strong communicator with good stakeholder management skills
  • Able to work across a range of markets and trades
  • Quantity Surveying or related background highly desirable
  • Proficient in CostX or similar estimating software


We genuinely care. We make it easy. We deliver certainty.

This is our promise - to our clients, and everyone we deal with. Delivering on these three things really, really well is what drives us at McNab. Everything we do, from recruiting and training to performance and promotion, centres around this promise.

We leverage the entire McNab Group to deliver certainty for our clients at a time of unprecedented uncertainty in the industry. And our approach works. From delivering our own property developments, to manufacturing our own building products, and a plethora of aligned businesses, your career at McNab goes well beyond traditional construction roles.


McNab benefits:

  • Annual health and fitness subsidy.
  • Parental leave program.
  • Birthday leave.
  • Access to the Employee Assistance Program and McNab Wellbeing Program
  • Internal development opportunities through tailored training programs.

This is an outstanding opportunity to build a strong career with a reputable construction company that genuinely cares about the development of all staff - if this is something you want to be a part of APPLY NOW!

title: Field Technician III
description:
Overview


Responsible for day-to-day SRO completion, downstream and upstream SNR maintenance and repair, troubleshooting and repair of all aspects of the HFC network from the node to the end of line, HFC (Hybrid Fibre Coaxial) node activation. RF alignment, node power supply troubleshooting, Outside Plant Construction (consisting of Aerial and Underground infrastructure), including new builds to support HFC plant extensions, FTTH Developments and Commercial Installations, installation and activation of new Outside Plant passive and active devices, construction of underground chambers inclusive of underground enclosures. This role also supports the requirements for mean time to repair Outside Plant faults/outages on the HFC and fibre transmission network.


Responsibilities


  • Troubleshoot, locate, and rectify reports of system deficiencies on the HFC Network.
  • Recognize, troubleshoot, and repair ingress/egress events which are adversely affecting node SNR performance to meet Outside Plant KPIâs.
  • Ensure overall system performance and picture quality by maintaining nodes and distribution amplifiers, passive devices in accordance with design specifications.
  • Perform quality control tests and checks in the HFC Network.
  • Replace defective Outside Plant, Network equipment that contributes to RF degradation in the HFC Network.
  • Activate and align HFC network equipment, including distribution active devices.
  • Read, understand, and interpret fibre designs.
  • Timely troubleshooting of service impacting, HFC Network outages to meet Outside Plant Reliability KPIâs.
  • Regular, consistent, and punctual attendance at work.
  • Operate company vehicles in a safe and responsible manner.
  • Communicate with NOC Support and all relevant personnel in a timely manner, during Network restoration activity.
  • Timely completion of construction activity and daily assigned tasks.
  • Timely completion of Outside Plant commercial installation construction requirements.
  • Timely completion of construction repairs and requirements for restorations to the fibre network.
  • Timely completion of construction repairs and requirements for restorations of the Aliv fibre transmission network.
  • Respond to utility pole transfers or relocation requests.
  • Oversee and maintain contractor relations to ensure the timely completion of projects.
  • Provide Support to Network Design Team for RFP site survey details as well as any new additions or changes to the Outside Plant.
  • Work in conjunction with other utility Companies and private contractors for coordination of request requirements (to include, but not limited to utility locate requests).
  • Ensure all OSP construction activity is of high quality and meets installation guidelines.
  • Be responsive and professional in addressing escalated customer service issues.
  • Coordinate the availability of as-built aerial construction designs upon completion of network buildouts for new trunk, distribution, and service drop layouts.
  • Maintain all company assigned assets (inclusive of but not limited to test equipment, tablets and specialized tools).
  • Participate in Department training initiatives and requirements.
  • Submit purchase order requisitions and return of receipts for vendor invoices.
  • Ability to work flexible hours including nights, weekends, and holidays as necessary.
  • Ability to travel to inter Family Islands to complete/respond to Engineering work requirements.
  • Properly maintain company assigned vehicle interior/exterior and assigned test equipment.
  • Operate company vehicles in a safe and responsible manner. Adhere to all company safety policies.
  • Communicate with upper Management on all relevant reporting requirements in a timely manner.
  • Participate in the On Call rotation schedule.
  • Adhere to Cable Bahamas Health & Safety policies, processes, and procedures.
  • Perform any other related duties associated with the daily functions of the Engineering Department as assigned by Management.


Qualifications


  • Up to a minimum of 5 yearsâ experience in the cable industry with knowledge of Outside Plant Operations (inclusive of but not limited to, Installation, Service, Construction, Preventative Maintenance of a HFC Network and fibre network topology.
  • Minimum of an Associate Degree or Certification in Construction, HFC or Fiber.
  • Must have a basic knowledge of Microsoft application.
  • Good communication and organizational skills .
  • Ability to consistently display a high level of both internal and external customer service and interpersonal competencies.
  • Must exhibit the ability to function independently in a safe, efficient manner and assume increased responsibilities as necessary to drive improved NPS .
  • Must have physical dexterity for pole climbing and working in all weather conditions.
  • Acceptable physical condition to enable crawling, bending, stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, pulling, pushing, grasping, climbing, lifting 75 pounds, working with general hand tools and a 32-foot ladder.
  • Willingness to learn about all aspects of business.

title: Account Executive (m/w/d)
Senior Software Engineer, Agents
description:
About Eye Security

Eye Security is an international scale-up providing cyber security with embedded cyber insurance to SMBs in Europe. Our cyber security innovations, state-of-the-art automation and platforms are being built and maintained by our Product and Engineering Teams. Our engineers and product managers collaborate closely with cyber security experts to ensure that their hacker's mindset is embedded into our platform.

Our platform is a proprietary Open XDR (eXtended Detection Response) system that brings in security data from several market leading cyber security products into our centralised repository. From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe.

About this role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Agentic SOC team. At Eye, we organise engineering around streams: mission-driven groups with a clear outcome to drive, not a product area or a section of the codebase. This team's mission is to build LLM-powered agents that augment our security analysts, taking on repetitive investigation and triage work so humans can focus on the judgment-heavy parts of the job.

You will work in a small, full-stack team of 2 to 3 engineers contributing to your stream's goal, working across whatever systems and layers are needed to deliver it. This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not a queue of tickets, and who is excited about shipping agents into a real production SOC where correctness, latency, and cost all matter.

In this role

  • Own features end-to-end as Feature Lead: scope the problem, coordinate work within your team, make day-to-day technical decisions, and ship it to production. You are trusted to take a high-level goal and turn it into a plan without close supervision.

  • Lead the design and delivery of LLM agents that plug into our SOC workflows, including tool design, prompt and context engineering, evals, and guardrails. Make sound tradeoffs on accuracy, cost, latency, and how much autonomy to give the agent versus keeping a human in the loop.

  • Drive technical design discussions in your stream and, where the work calls for it, influence architecture and standards beyond it. Set the bar for code quality, testing, and documentation on your team.

  • Ground engineering decisions in outcomes. Push back when the "why" is unclear, propose simpler or faster paths to the business result, and stay close to the security analysts and customers your agents are meant to serve.

  • Mentor engineers on your team and across the stream through pairing, code review, and design feedback. Act as a multiplier, not just a strong individual contributor.

  • Participate in hiring: interview candidates, help shape the bar, and support onboarding.

  • Contribute to a psychologically safe and outcome-oriented team culture. Lead by example in incidents and high-pressure moments.

  • The role is remote in the Netherlands or in Berlin, with a commitment to travel to the office (The Hague or Berlin) twice per week.

What you will need

  • 5+ years of development experience, including meaningful full-stack exposure. You are comfortable working across backend and frontend layers and you pick up new technologies independently.

  • Depth in at least one technical area and broad competence across the stack. You have designed and shipped systems where performance, security, reliability, and maintainability all mattered, and you can explain the tradeoffs you made.

  • Experience with strongly typed languages (Typescript, Java, dotnet, PHP, or similar). We operate in Go and React, and we back ourselves to get a seasoned engineer with strongly typed experience up to speed in our stack quickly.

  • Hands-on experience building LLM agents, with evidence they were useful. You have built and shipped at least one non-trivial LLM-powered agent or agentic workflow, in production or as a side project with real users. You can speak concretely about the design choices you made around tool use, context and state, evals, failure handling, autonomy, cost, and latency and, just as importantly, what the agent changed for the people using it.

  • Comfortable using AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow.

  • A track record of raising the level of engineers around you through mentoring, code review, and design feedback.

  • Strong communication skills. You can translate technical tradeoffs for engineers, product managers, and leadership, and you write designs and decisions in a way others can build on.

  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and secure development principles to build safe, trusted systems.

  • Fluency in English is a must.

What we offer

  • Work on genuinely hard problems in a complex domain: XDR, security data at scale, and tooling that empowers security analysts to protect hundreds of customers across Europe.

  • Real ownership in a small, autonomous team where every engineer is close to the work, close to the decision-making, and close to the impact.

  • A deliberate bet on AI-augmented engineering and AI-augmented security operations: we are building toward small teams that punch well above their weight through smart AI adoption, and you will be part of shaping how that works in practice for both how we build and how our SOC operates.

  • Be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the future of our technology infrastructure.

  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.

  • Join a young and thriving scale-up which is on its way to becoming the category leader in Europe.

  • We are a great place to work, filled with people who enjoy working together.

We are a rapidly growing company and believe in investing in our people. If you're a highly motivated and results-oriented engineer with a passion for building secure, scalable technologies, we encourage you to apply!

Why Join Semperis?
You’ll be part of a global team on the front lines of cybersecurity innovation. At Semperis, we celebrate curiosity, integrity, and people who take initiative. Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.400 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus.


Deine Mission bei ]init[

Du gestaltest digitale Anwendungen, die Menschen wirklich nutzen – und du denkst dabei nicht erst ab dem Screen, sondern ab dem Kundenziel und Nutzungsproblem. Als Senior UI/UX Designer (all genders) trägst du in interdisziplinären Projektteams die Verantwortung für die Gestaltung und Nutzerzentrierung komplexer Fachanwendungen, Portale und Informationsangebote – im Public und Health Sector ebenso wie in regulierten Branchen der Privatwirtschaft, etwa im Energiesektor.

Du bewegst dich sicher zwischen Kundenanforderungen, Erkenntnissen aus der Nutzerforschung, Konzeption und visueller Umsetzung: Du denkst Design strategisch, treibst Design-Prozesse voran und verbindest konzeptionelle Stärke mit einem hohen Maß an visueller Präzision – auch an der Schnittstelle zwischen Gestaltung und technischer Umsetzung. Designsysteme sind für dich dabei kein Nebenprodukt, sondern das Rückgrat deiner Arbeit: Du baust sie auf, hältst sie über Produkte hinweg konsistent und sorgst dafür, dass sie in der Entwicklung tatsächlich ankommen. Und du nutzt KI dort, wo sie deine Arbeit besser macht: schneller zu Varianten und Umsetzung, breiter in Recherche und Analyse, konsequenter in der Qualitätssicherung – ohne die Entscheidung aus der Hand zu geben.


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du verantwortest den Designprozess in Kundenprojekten, von der Vision und Definition der Design-Sprache bis zum finalen UI. Du gestaltest visuell und fachlich anspruchsvolle Benutzerflows und Oberflächen für komplexe Anwendungen konsistent, zugänglich und umsetzbar
  • Du berätst strategisch unsere Kund:innen und Projektteams bei der Weiterentwicklung ihrer digitalen Produkte: Du bringst Nutzersicht und Marktbeobachtung zusammen, zeigst Optionen auf und begründest Designentscheidungen so, dass sie im Haus des Kunden tragen
  • Du verantwortest Designsysteme über ihren gesamten Lebenszyklus und sorgst dafür, dass das Designsystem im Team gelebt wird: Dokumentation, Contribution-Regeln, Reviews und Schulung von Kolleg:innen und Kund:innen
  • Du berätst Kund:innen auf Augenhöhe, moderierst Workshops und machst Designentscheidungen nachvollziehbar – auch gegenüber nicht-gestalterischen Stakeholdern. Wo Produkt und Kommunikation zusammenwirken, denkst du beides zusammen
  • Du übernimmst die kreative Federführung bei Angeboten und Ausschreibungen und präsentierst in Pitches
  • Du setzt KI-Tools gezielt im Designprozess ein und teilst deine Erfahrungen im Team
  • Du übernimmst du die fachliche Leitung kleiner UX/UI-Teams in Kundenprojekten, gibst Impulse ins Team durch Design Reviews, Qualitätssicherung und Mentoring von Kolleg:innen


Das bringst du mit

Must-haves

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Gestaltung digitaler Produkte mit Schwerpunkt UX- und UI-Design
  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Kommunikationsdesign, Interaction Design, Medieninformatik, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Entwicklung, Anwendung und Weiterentwicklung von Designsystemen sowie ein ausgeprägtes Qualitätsverständnis und visuelles Stilgefühl
  • Sicherer Umgang mit UX-Methoden, der Gestaltung komplexer digitaler Anwendungen sowie den Anforderungen an digitale Barrierefreiheit
  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklungsteams in agilen Umfeldern sowie in der Moderation von Workshops und Präsentation von Designlösungen gegenüber Kund:innen und Stakeholdern.
  • Aussagekräftiges Portfolio, in dem du deine Arbeit von der Problemstellung bis zum finalen Interface sowie deine Erfahrung mit Designsystemen zeigst
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. 
Nice-to-haves
  • Erfahrung in regulierten Branchen wie Public Sector, Health, Energie.
  • Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung kleiner Designteams in Kundenprojekten.
  • Erfahrung in der Art Direktion
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-gestützten Produkten, Designprozessen, Prototyping oder Code-Generierung.


Das bieten wir dir

  • Because we care: 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden.
  • Work with us: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und Teilzeitmodelle ermöglichen dir, Arbeit und Alltag passend zu gestalten – immer abgestimmt mit deinem Team und deinen Projekten.
  • Learn with us: Mit der ]init[ Academy, Trainings, Zertifizierungen und bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Grow with us: Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg:innen kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Ride with us: JobRad, ÖPNV-Zuschuss und weitere Mobility Benefits unterstützen dich dabei, flexibel und nachhaltig unterwegs zu sein.
  • Start with us: Welcome Week, strukturiertes Onboarding und Patenschaften sorgen für einen gelungenen Einstieg und helfen dir, schnell im Team und deinen Projekten anzukommen.


Werde Teil des Teams

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft – in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, remote oder im Office.

description:
Your mission

Are you a social media and digital marketing expert (m/f/d) who wants to turn breakthrough photonic computing technology into a brand people talk about? You are interested in working in a deep tech company and have the ability to transport highly specialized technology messages to our social media audience? Than Q.ANT is a great opportunity for you as a Senior Social Media & Digital Marketing Manager (m/f/d) to own our social media presence, grow our digital footprint across LinkedIn, X and beyond, and translate deep tech into engaging content for a global B2B audience.

As Senior Social Media & Digital Marketing Manager (m/f/d), you will own Q.ANT’s social media presence end-to-end and support the operative execution of the CEO’s personal social media channels in close coordination with the CEO Office. You’ll turn complex technical topics into clear, engaging storytelling that strengthens our brand positioning, visibility and business goals.

Your responsibilities:

  • Own and coordinate content and channel strategy across Q.ANT’s social media and digital channels (LinkedIn today, with X, Instagram and YouTube to follow, plus newsletter and paid campaigns)
  • Coordinate closely with the CEO Office on the operative execution of the CEO’s personal social media channels
  • Manage and continuously optimize editorial calendars and oversee content production workflows
  • Lead community management — responding to comments, messages and posts — across all social media channels
  • Own Q.ANT’s broader digital marketing channels, including email marketing and paid campaigns across social, search and emerging AI-driven search engines
  • Align content and channel initiatives with marketing, business development, hardware and software product management, and leadership to support strategic objectives
  • Coordinate with external partners and agencies
  • Operate with a high degree of autonomy; no formal people management responsibility, though you may guide working students on individual projects


Your Impact:
  • Drive Q.ANT’s brand visibility and positioning through strategic, consistent, high-quality content
  • Build and safeguard the CEO’s personal social media presence in coordination with the CEO Office
  • Expand Q.ANT’s digital footprint and inbound reach through paid campaigns and email marketing
  • Translate complex technology topics into clear, engaging communication for different audiences
  • Support lead generation and employer branding through targeted content initiatives
  • Ensure a professional, cohesive brand presence across all digital channels



Your profile

Education: 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a comparable field.

Experience:

  • 3+ years of proven experience in social media management, with a focus on B2B-relevant channels such as LinkedIn, X and beyond
  • Experience creating content for multiple formats and channels (e.g. social media, newsletters)
  • Experience with email marketing and paid social campaigns
  • Experience in community management (responding to comments and direct messages) on social media platforms
  • Ideally, experience in B2B, tech, or innovation-driven environments
Technical knowledge:
  • Strong understanding of social media platforms, especially B2B channels like LinkedIn and X
  • Knowledge of content strategy, storytelling and product communication
  • Strong understanding of performance metrics and content optimization
  • Understanding of brand aesthetics, positioning and tone of voice
  • Knowledge of paid social and search advertising, and email marketing best practices
  • Ability to adapt content to different target audiences
Tools & platforms: 
Canva; ideally HubSpot (social media management, planning and distribution, and email marketing); native platform analytics tools; paid media platforms such as LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads

Languages: 
Fluent in English and German

Core competencies we value: 
Solution orientation, ownership, communication, collaboration, commitment and self-leadership.


Why us?

  • We hire for attitude and train for skills.

  • We encourage self-responsibility and accelerate professional development.

  • We move fast and encourage experimentation.

  • You have the opportunity to be part of developing breakthrough photonic computing technology and have a lasting impact on the future of computing.

  • You can be part of a passionate international, highly skilled cross-functional team.

  • You will have access to the founders of the company.

title: Native Processing Server Architect (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission

The future of AI computing is light, not electrons.  
At Q.ANT, we are building photonic processing systems that compute with light—delivering a scalable, energy-efficient alternative to transistor-based architectures for next-generation AI and high-performance computing. 
As our Native Processing Server Architect (m/f/d), within our Operations team, you will operate at the intersection of deep engineering execution and forward-looking platform architecture. You will take ownership of designing, building, and evolving our Native Processing Server (NPS) platform—from prototype construction and hardware evaluation to scaling strategies and deployment concepts. Hands-on with hardware and systems, you don't just specify architectures, you build, test, and validate them, directly shaping how our photonic technology reaches production and field environments.

1KOMMA5°

Bei 1KOMMA5° verfolgen wir eine Vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. Dafür bauen wir mit Heartbeat AI das Energiesystem der Zukunft. Bist du dabei? 

Wir bringen regionales Handwerk und skalierbare Software zusammen: Solar, Speicher, Wärmepumpe und E-Mobilität denken wir nicht einzeln, sondern steuern sie als intelligentes, integriertes Gesamtsystem in unserem virtuellen Kraftwerk. Direkt verbunden mit dem Strommarkt – in Echtzeit, vollautomatisiert. So wird Energie dann genutzt, wenn sie erneuerbar verfügbar und besonders günstig ist. Bis 2030 wollen wir 1,5 Millionen Haushalte auf erneuerbare Energien umstellen. Über 3.000 Menschen arbeiten jeden Tag daran, an mehr als 80 Standorten weltweit, von Finnland bis Australien. 

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und Lösungen bauen, die wirklich zählen? Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die Energiewelt von morgen.


Deine Position

  • Analyse unserer Vertriebskennzahlen entlang des gesamten Sales Funnels – von Lead bis Abschluss – sowie Identifikation von Trends, Engpässen und Wachstumspotenzialen
  • Entwicklung aussagekräftiger Reports, Dashboards und KPI-Auswertungen, die Transparenz über die Vertriebsperformance schaffen und datenbasierte Entscheidungen ermöglichen
  • Unterstützung beim Forecasting, Pipeline Management und der operativen Vertriebssteuerung auf Basis belastbarer Daten
  • Identifikation von Automatisierungs- und Optimierungspotenzialen sowie Umsetzung effizienter und skalierbarer Prozesse im Vertriebsumfeld
  • Weiterentwicklung unserer Sales-Prozesse und Reporting-Standards gemeinsam mit dem Sales-Team
  • Sicherstellung einer hohen Datenqualität im CRM sowie Mitgestaltung einheitlicher Standards für Datenerfassung und Datenpflege
  • Unterstützung bei der Einführung, Weiterentwicklung und Integration von CRM-, Reporting- und Sales-Tools
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Sales, Marketing, Finance und der Geschäftsführung als analytische Schnittstelle für datengetriebene Entscheidungen


Dein Profil

  • Laufendes Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Informatik, Mathematik oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs
  • Erste praktische Erfahrungen im Bereich Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Analytics, Consulting oder einer vergleichbaren analytischen Rolle – beispielsweise durch Werkstudententätigkeiten, Praktika oder eigene Projekte
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Excel oder Google Sheets sowie idealerweise erste Erfahrungen mit SQL und BI-Tools wie Power BI, Looker oder Tableau
  • Interesse an CRM-Systemen sowie datengetriebenen Vertriebsprozessen und deren kontinuierlicher Optimierung
  • Analytische Stärke sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Daten verständlich aufzubereiten und daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen abzuleiten
  • Strukturierte, eigenständige und prozessorientierte Arbeitsweise mit hoher Umsetzungsorientierung
  • Interesse an Automatisierung, KI-gestützten Workflows und effizienten Prozessen
  • Kommunikationsstärke sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Teams und Stakeholdern
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse


Benefits

  • Sammle praktische Erfahrung an der Schnittstelle von Sales, Analytics und Operations und arbeite an Themen mit direktem Einfluss auf unsere Vertriebssteuerung
  • Übernimm früh Verantwortung für eigene Analysen, Reports und Projekte und bringe Deine Ideen zur Optimierung unserer Prozesse ein
  • Lerne moderne Tools und Technologien wie CRM-Systeme, BI-Lösungen und Automatisierungen im operativen Einsatz kennen
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, hybrides Arbeiten sowie moderne Arbeitsausstattung mit MacBook und iPhone – auch zur privaten Nutzung
  • Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten sowie regelmäßiges Feedback für Deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung
  • Zugang zu EGYM Wellpass sowie attraktive Mitarbeitervorteile über FutureBens
  • Werde Teil eines ambitionierten Teams mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, offener Kommunikation und einer gemeinsamen Mission, die Energiewende voranzutreiben

title: Werkstudent:in Projektkoordination Wärmepumpe (m/w/d) - Berlin / Remote
description:
1KOMMA5°

Bei 1KOMMA5° bauen wir Europas führende Energie-Software-Plattform “Heartbeat” und schaffen so ein virtuelles Kraftwerk, das Photovoltaik, Stromspeicher, Wärmepumpen und Ladesäulen der Kunden verknüpft und so die Rentabilität vernetzter Kundenanlagen deutlich erhöht. Wir bieten Kunden zudem einen "One-Stop-Shop" für den Kauf und die Installation individueller und intelligenter Energie-Systemlösungen, damit jeder Haushalt schnell und professionell klimaneutral wohnen, heizen und mobil sein kann. Gleichzeitig arbeiten wir in unserer Technologie-Sparte an der Weiterentwicklung und dem Ausbau der Heartbeat-Software, um Kunden weltweit mit dem Strommarkt zu vernetzen und so immer den günstigsten und saubersten Stromtarif anbieten zu können.

Hast du Lust, die Energierevolution mit uns anzugehen? Dann bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unserer Mission!


Deine Position

  • Motivation & Mindset: Du bringst eine ausgeprägte Can-do-Mentalität mit, arbeitest gerne operativ und unterstützt das Team flexibel dort, wo du gebraucht wirst – ohne deinen Qualitätsanspruch aus den Augen zu verlieren.

  • Studium & Interesse: Du absolvierst aktuell ein Studium (z. B. Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, BWL, Logistik, Projektmanagement oder vergleichbar), begeisterst dich für die Cleantech-Branche oder möchtest dich beruflich weiter orientieren.

  • Organisationstalent: Eine strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und präzise Arbeitsweise zeichnet dich aus. Auch bei parallelen Aufgaben behältst du stets den Überblick.

  • Verfügbarkeit: Du bist für mindestens 3, idealerweise 6 Monate verfügbar (gerne auch im Rahmen eines Pflichtpraktikums).

  • Hands-on Support: Du packst im operativen Tagesgeschäft der Projektkoordination mit an und sorgst für verlässliche Planungsprozesse.

  • Kapazitäts- & Terminmanagement: Du koordinierst Baustellentermine mit unseren Standorten, behältst den Überblick über Kalender und stimmst die Abläufe optimal auf die Gegebenheiten vor Ort ab.

  • Partnerkoordination: Als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen unserem Team, den Standorten und externen Wärmepumpen-Partnern begleitest du Baustellendurchsprachen und stehst als Ansprechperson bereit.

  • System- & Datenpflege: Du pflegst Projektdaten und Terminstände präzise in unsere internen Systeme ein und stellst eine hohe Datenqualität sicher.


Benefits

  • Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Berlin oder remote
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Viel Eigenverantwortung und die Möglichkeit, eigene Themen zu übernehmen
  • Direkter Einblick in strategische Entscheidungen auf VP-Ebene
  • Ein gesunder Arbeitsplatz und Fitnessprogramm Wellpass
  • Bei uns gibt es Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Du kannst aktiv mitgestalten und leistest mit Deiner Arbeit einen Beitrag zur Energiewende

Bis 2030 wollen wir 1,5 Millionen Haushalte auf erneuerbare Energien umstellen. Über 3.000 Menschen arbeiten jeden Tag daran, an mehr als 80 Standorten weltweit, von Finnland bis Australien. 

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und Lösungen bauen, die wirklich zählen? Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die Energiewelt von morgen.


Deine Position

Du verantwortest SEO und GEO für alle Märkte von 1KOMMA5°, von Finnland bis Australien. Klassische Suche und AI Search denkst du dabei zusammen: Was in der Google-SERP funktioniert, muss auch in ChatGPT, Perplexity und den AI Overviews ankommen. Dafür baust du content-getriebene Organic-Growth-Modelle, die über Märkte hinweg tragen, und automatisierst mit KI alles, was sich automatisieren lässt.

  • Strategie & internationale Steuerung: Du entwickelst die globale SEO- und GEO-Strategie, priorisierst über Märkte hinweg und setzt Ziele entlang des Funnels: von Sichtbarkeit über qualifizierte Anfragen bis zum Beitrag auf den CAC. Die Teams in den Ländern machst du mit klaren Briefings und gemeinsamen Standards handlungsfähig. Ihre Insights fließen zurück in die Strategie
  • Team, Agenturen & Freelancer: Du führst ein kleines Team, entwickelst es fachlich weiter und baust es mit deinen Anforderungen aus. Agenturen und Freelancer steuerst du inhaltlich und wirtschaftlich, vom Briefing über die Qualität bis zum Budget
  • Content-getriebener Organic Growth: Du baust Organic-Growth-Modelle auf und bringst sie in neue Märkte, von Keyword- und Wettbewerbsrecherche über die Content-Roadmap bis zur Qualitätssicherung auf der Website. Die Content-Strategie verantwortest du gemeinsam mit den Content Managern im Department: Du bringst die Search-Perspektive ein, sie den redaktionellen Blick
  • GEO & AEO (Modern Search): Du richtest unsere Inhalte so aus, dass sie in KI-gestützten Suchergebnissen sichtbar sind, machst diese Sichtbarkeit messbar und leitest daraus die nächsten Schritte ab
  • AI-Workflows, Daten & Technik: Du baust automatisierte SEO-Prozesse mit LLMs und Tools wie n8n oder Make, für Briefings, Content-QA und Monitoring. Mit Search Console, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog und GA4 hältst du die Website technisch sauber und übersetzt Auffälligkeiten direkt in Maßnahmen
  • Du übernimmst ein kleines Team und formst es weiter. Und du bleibst nah an der Arbeit: Strategie schreiben und selbst in den Crawl gehen sind hier kein Widerspruch


Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung & nachgewiesenes Wachstum: 6+ Jahre SEO (Inhouse oder Agentur), davon Erfahrung in einer Rolle mit strategischer Verantwortung oder über mehrere Märkte hinweg. Du hast content-getriebene Organic-Growth-Modelle aufgebaut und verantwortet, nicht nur umgesetzt. Deinen Erfolg misst du an qualifizierten Leads und am Beitrag zum CAC, nicht an Rankings und Sessions. Wenn organischer Traffic steigt, aber keine Anfragen daraus entstehen, ist das für dich kein Erfolg
  • Führung & Steuerung: Du hast schon Menschen geführt oder fachlich angeleitet und externe Dienstleister gesteuert. Ein kleines Team zu entwickeln reizt dich mehr, als ein großes zu verwalten
  • Daten & Tools: Du beherrschst die gängigen SEO- und Analytics-Tools sicher und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Daten, nicht auf Basis von Bauchgefühl
  • AI-Affinität & Modern Search: Du arbeitest täglich mit LLMs, hast Automatisierungen selbst gebaut und verfolgst die Entwicklung von AI Search so genau, dass du Veränderungen früh erkennst und einordnest
  • Hands-on & Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe: Du denkst strategisch, gehst aber auch selbst ins Sheet, in den Crawl oder ins Briefing. Und du bringst Menschen hinter eine Richtung, die dir nicht unterstellt sind: mit Argumenten, Klarheit und Verlässlichkeit
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch (C-Level)


Benefits

  • Du hast die Möglichkeit in unseren brandneuen Büros in der Hamburger Innenstadt, Berlin & München zu arbeiten und/oder remote
  • Nutze dein technisches Equipment auch abseits der Arbeit in deiner Freizeit 
  • Du bist Teil eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens mit viel Entwicklungspotenzial, wo du eigenständig etwas aufbauen kannst und deinen Impact spürst
  • Bewege dich in flachen Hierarchien, übernimm schon während deiner Einarbeitung Verantwortung und arbeite direkt mit Teilen des Managements zusammen
  • Mit deiner Arbeit unterstützt du den Megatrend “Energie- und Mobilitätswende” und leistest einen konkreten Beitrag zum nachhaltigen Umbau unserer Energie-Infrastruktur
  • Sei aktiv und nutze das Angebot von über 7.600 Sportpartnern mit dem EGYM-Wellpass
  • Ob Citybike oder E-Bike – mit unserem Jobrad-Leasing bleibst du flexibel und bist umweltfreundlich unterwegs
  • Profitiere von Benefits & Rabatten durch Futurebens

title: Senior Software Engineer (m/f/d): AI-Native Development
description:
Job Description

We protect our customers’ digital infrastructure, keeping it secure, fast, and online, even under active attack. As a cybersecurity provider, we run high-performance systems in a genuinely hostile environment, where code quality, security, and rigorous input validation are not hygiene: they are the product. Our customers trust us with business-critical traffic, and we build and operate to the highest standards of certification for critical infrastructure.

As a Senior Software Engineer (m/f/d), you will help your team design and build robust solutions for complex problems. We are looking for someone who thinks in systems, who starts from the problem, reasons about the trade-offs of the environment it will run in, and reaches for the tool that fits, rather than the one on their CV. We are constantly improving our applications and we work AI-natively: AI coding agents are part of how we spec, build, and review every day. We strongly believe in “you build it, you run it, you own it” and a “collaboration culture”, where you and the team are on the frontlines and driving the change together!


Your Responsibilities

  • Own features end-to-end, from backend service design through to the frontend slice the feature needs, in an international, cross-functional team of software engineers, QA and OPS professionals
  • Design, validate and advocate architecture decisions for your team’s verticals, with a bias toward well-structured, service-oriented backends
  • Work AI-natively: use AI coding agents as core tooling to move faster and raise quality, while staying fully accountable for the code you ship
  • Drive technical discussions and decisions with your team
  • Push toward continuous delivery, improving both the software and how we build it
  • Write code that performs, and holds up in production under hostile, high-volume traffic, with security and input validation built in from the start


Your Qualifications

  • You think in systems. You start from the problem and the constraints, not from a favorite language. To you the difference between languages is largely syntax; what actually matters is the environment code runs in: performance, portability, compatibility, operational cost, and long-term maintenance
  • You can explain your choices. You can walk us through a time you chose one language or runtime over another, and the trade-offs that drove the decision, and you can do the same for the frontend when a feature calls for it
  • You’ve gone deep, not just broad. At least 5 years of intensive, hands-on coding and engineering experience — this is a senior role and not a fit for juniors — with genuine depth in at least one or two ecosystems. Our stack today is mostly PHP / Symfony, React and GraphQL; Edge systems use C, Rust and Python mostly. 
  • We care a lot about experience with Python, Go, C and/or Rust. These are parts that are being introduced to our dev department and where a significant part of our edge logic is based in, and someone who already reasons and builds fluently in them will make an outsized difference; this is a real signal for us, not a nice-to-have footnote
  • Security and code quality are instincts, not afterthoughts. You write code that holds up under hostile, high-volume traffic; you treat every input as untrusted, validate rigorously, and understand how a weak boundary or a hot-path regression becomes an attack surface. Reliability under load is a first-class concern for you
  • You’re fluent with AI-assisted development. You treat AI coding agents as core tooling; you know their strengths and limits, and you own the outcome (including reviewing AI-written code for exactly the security and validation gaps above)
  • You reason comfortably about the whole picture: APIs, services, data, and the frontend the feature owns; you don’t stop at a language boundary
  • You're at home on Linux systems, and CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and deployment considerations are a natural part of how you think about shipping software, not foreign territory
  • Curious by default; you like to validate ideas hands-on with POCs and RFCs
  • At home in an agile team with structured requirements, and quick to learn
  • You speak and write English fluently

title: System Engineer / Systemadministrator (m/w/d) - 3rd Level
description:
Du bist sicher in Microsoft-Umgebungen – aber keine Lust, deine Zeit im First- und Second-Level zu verbrennen? Und du willst Projekte endlich selbst umsetzen, statt sie nur zu koordinieren?

Für einen Managed Service Provider aus Lübeck – Teil eines bundesweit wachsenden IT-Netzwerks – suche ich Verstärkung fürs Technik-Team. Betreut werden mittelständische Kunden, durchgängig auf Microsoft-Basis. Das Besondere: Den kompletten First- und Second-Level übernimmt ein zentraler Helpdesk – über 90 Prozent aller Tickets siehst du nie. Bei dir landen die anspruchsvollen Themen: Third-Level, Kundenprojekte und gelegentliche Vor-Ort-Termine. Du bist der Techniker, der Lösungen wirklich baut und beim Kunden als Experte auftritt – kein Ticket-Fließband, keine Rufbereitschaft. Vor Ort ein greifbares Team mit kurzen Wegen, im Rücken die Prozesse, die Akademie und die Einkaufsmacht eines großen Netzwerks.

Aufgaben

  • Third-Level-Support: Du löst die komplexen Störungen, die der zentrale Helpdesk nicht abfängt – eigenständig, nachvollziehbar und mit dem Anspruch, es sauber zu lösen.
  • Kundenprojekte umsetzen: Du setzt IT-Infrastrukturprojekte eigenverantwortlich um - hierbei erwartet dich eine Vielfalt im Mircosoft-Umfeld
  • Onboarding neuer Kunden: Du nimmst Kundenumgebungen auf, dokumentierst und standardisierst sie und machst sie sauber betreubar – mit allem, was dazugehört.
  • Beim Kunden vor Ort: Höchstens etwa 1x pro Woche, eher 1x alle 2 Wochen – bist du beim Kunden, regional (max. 1,5h Fahrzeit) und innerhalb der Arbeitszeit - dafür steht ein Tesla Model Y bereit.

Qualifikation

  • Microsoft-Basis: Du bist sicher in der Administration von M365 (u. a. Tenants, Exchange Online) und Windows Server – on-premises wie hybrid, inklusive Active Directory und Virtualisierung (z. B. Hyper-V).
  • Fokus reicht: Du bist sicher in einem, sehr gerne auch zwei Bereichen – idealerweise M365, gern plus Windows Server. Netzwerk (LAN, VLAN, VPN), Firewalls, Backup oder Monitoring sind ein willkommenes Plus, den Rest lernst du hier.
  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Du setzt Projekte selbst technisch um, statt sie zu delegieren, und behältst zwischen Tickets, Projekten und Terminen die Ruhe und Priorität.
  • Erfahrung & Auftreten: Du bringst mindestens rund drei Jahre einschlägige Praxis mit, trittst beim Kunden über alle Ebenen souverän auf und sprichst fließend Deutsch

Benefits

  • Abwechslung statt Routine: Wechselnde Kundenumgebungen und echte Third-Level-Themen – nie 26-mal dasselbe Ticket, sondern immer wieder etwas Neues zu lösen.
  • Weiterentwicklung: Akademie, Technikertreffen zweimal im Jahr und ab Oktober die Copilot-Ausbildungsreihe – dazu KI, die im Support-Desk schon mitarbeitet und aus der Telefonannahme automatisch Tickets erstellt.
  • Moderne Ausstattung: Surface Pro als Arbeitsgerät, Diensthandy und ein modernes, offen gestaltetes Büro – gute Hardware ist hier keine Diskussion.
  • Konditionen & Benefits: Unbefristete Festanstellung, 30 Urlaubstage, faires Vergütungspaket (100 % Fixum), JobRad, Firmenfitness und betriebliche Altersvorsorge.

Klingt nach dir? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!

In einem gemeinsamen Termin verrate ich dir mehr zum Unternehmen und freue mich auch, mehr zu dir zu erfahren.

title: (Senior) Applied Scientist, Recommendations
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Wolt is part of DoorDash - together we form one of the world's largest local commerce platforms. We build recommendation systems that help customers discover the most relevant restaurants, dishes and items throughout their Wolt experience.

We are looking for an Applied Scientist to advance the machine learning models behind these experiences. You'll work on challenging applied ML problems where model quality, product decisions and customer experience are tightly connected. This is an opportunity to take ideas from problem framing and data analysis through experimentation, production deployment and measurable customer impact.

What you'll be doing

  • Design, develop and improve recommendation, ranking and retrieval models that surface relevant restaurants, dishes, items and content to customers.
  • Own applied ML problems end to end: frame the problem, analyze data, develop models, define offline evaluation, run experiments and monitor production performance.
  • Develop methods that balance relevance with product and customer needs, such as diversity, availability, business constraints and changing user intent.
  • Collaborate closely with Software Engineers, ML Engineers, Product Managers and Analysts to turn scientific insights into reliable customer-facing products.
  • Evaluate and apply state-of-the-art ML methods where they meaningfully improve recommendation quality, robustness or efficiency.
  • Contribute to a high bar for applied-science practice through technical reviews, knowledge sharing and thoughtful experimentation.

Our humble expectations

  • You have substantial hands-on experience applying machine learning to real-world problems and a track record of bringing models from development into production; a PhD with relevant applied research experience is equally welcome.
  • You have experience with recommendation systems, ranking, retrieval, personalisation, or closely related ML problems.
  • You can independently turn an ambiguous customer or product problem into a well-scoped ML approach, make sound trade-offs and drive it to a measurable outcome.
  • You are proficient in Python and experienced with modern ML frameworks and large-scale data processing.
  • You understand how to evaluate ML systems rigorously, including offline metrics, experiment design and interpreting online results.
  • You communicate complex technical ideas clearly and work effectively with cross-functional partners.

What we offer

You will work on recommendation problems with direct, measurable impact on how customers discover relevant content. You'll collaborate with experienced scientists and engineers across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt, learning from multiple recommendation systems while helping shape the next generation of the experience.

Together with your lead, you will have the opportunity to create a personalised development plan that builds on your strengths and develops new capabilities.

 

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Forward Deployed Engineers turn what Luma's models can do into systems customers actually rely on. You embed with a customer, learn their workflow, define the problem with them, and build the production system that solves it, with their data and their constraints. You own both the relationship and the code.

This is engineering at the edge, where ambiguity is the default and "what should we build?" is yours to answer. It's built for people who've already been the single point of ownership on a hard problem: a technical founder, the engineer who flew out and rebuilt a customer's workflow, a consultant who actually wrote the system. If you need a PRD and a well-defined ticket queue, this isn't it.

What You'll Own

  • Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, constraints, and goals, and define the problem yourself.

  • Build production systems on Luma's APIs, models, and internal tools.

  • Prototype, ship, iterate, and maintain systems customers depend on in real environments with real data.

  • Own projects end to end, from first conversation to deployed system.

  • Build around platform gaps when something's missing, and feed recurring patterns back to platform and R&D to productize.

  • Use AI to accelerate implementation, while the core of the work stays engineering judgment: what to build and how to make it reliable.

First 90 Days

One way the first 90 could unfold.

  • Days 1–30 — Immerse & Diagnose: Embed with a first customer, learn their workflow, and define the real problem.

  • Days 30–60 — Ship & Validate: Build and deploy a production system they actually use.

  • Days 60–90 — Scale & Systemize: Spot the pattern worth productizing and work with R&D to turn it into platform.

What You Bring

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering, with software shipped end to end.

  • Strong proficiency in at least one general-purpose language (Python, TypeScript, Go, or similar).

  • Ability to work across the stack and learn unfamiliar systems quickly.

  • Bachelor's in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

  • Willingness to travel to client sites as needed.

Nice to Have

  • A track record of shipping real systems with real users, not just assigned tasks.

  • High agency and strong prioritization: you find the core problem and move.

  • Comfort defining your own path when there isn't one.

  • Evidence of working directly with customers and translating what you heard into what you built.

  • Clear communication, including explaining a technical decision to a non-technical stakeholder.

Luma's mission is to build unified general intelligence that can generate, understand, and operate in the physical world. We believe multimodality is critical for intelligence — the next step beyond language models comes from vision. Luma is an equal opportunity employer.

Mit der Kraft von Künstlicher Intelligenz wollen wir unsere Prozesse transformieren und die Branche neu definieren. Dafür suchen wir dich: einen Developer / Programmierer, der mit Leidenschaft intelligente Agenten sowie smarte Automatisierungen baut und diese stetig weiterentwickelt. Hierbei handelt es sich um eine Trainee-Stelle: Dafür musst du zwar Interesse an Digitalisierung, KI etc haben, aber keine Ausbildung, Berufserfahrung oder Ähnliches vorweisen. Wir bilden dich komplett aus!

Deine Mission beim DCF Verlag

  • Entwicklung, Implementierung und Wartung von KI-Agenten sowie digitalen Prozessen mit Tools wie n8n, Zapier, OpenAI, Antrophic und Make

  • Aufbau effizienter Automatisierungen für unsere PR- und Kommunikationsworkflows

  • Eigenverantwortliche Optimierung, um Geschwindigkeit, Präzision und Qualität weiter zu erhöhen

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Führungsteam, das KI als Schlüssel für das nächste Wachstumskapitel sieht

Warum wir?

Bei uns findest du kein starres Konzern-Denken. Wir sind schnell, zielorientiert und voller Energie. Wer zu uns kommt, sucht nicht einen Job, sondern eine Mission: gemeinsam etwas aufzubauen, das größer ist als jeder Einzelne. Wir sind überzeugt, dass Persönlichkeiten wie du genau das Fundament sind, um eine neue Ära in der PR-Branche einzuleiten.

  • Einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz: Der DCF Verlag möchte langfristig mit DIR wachsen. Seit der Gründung hat sich unser Team stetig vergrößert und so planen wir auch in den kommenden Jahren, neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen bei uns zu begrüßen.

  • Gute Vergütung und Karrierechancen: Unsere Mitarbeiter erhalten neben der Vergütung weitere vermögenswirksame Leistungen und Weihnachtsgeld. Auch die Option auf einen Firmenwagen ist gegeben.

  • Netzwerk und Wissen: Wir bieten dir ein großes Netzwerk und Wissen, um im Berufsleben richtig erfolgreich zu sein. Bei uns triffst du auf erfahrene Experten aus verschiedensten Branchen, lernst aber auch bei direkt im Unternehmen von herausragenden Kollegen und Kolleginnen.

  • Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung: Ob mit Büchern, Magazinen, Online-Kursen und Seminaren – wir wollen uns fortschreitend verbessern und legen Wert darauf, dass wir immer auf dem aktuellsten Stand sind. Nur so können wir die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse liefern.

  • Vielfältigkeit: Interessante Kunden, Themen und Projekte – beim DCF Verlag gibt es stets neue Aufgaben und Herausforderungen in verschiedensten Themengebieten.

  • Perfekt ausgestatteter Arbeitsplatz: Obst, Getränke, höhenverstellbare Tische, modernste Apple-Geräte u. v. m. erwartet dich beim DCF Verlag.


  • Starke analytische Fähigkeiten und Freude daran, komplexe Probleme klar zu strukturieren

  • Ehrgeiz, Dinge nicht nur „irgendwie“ zu erledigen, sondern wirklich die beste Lösung zu schaffen

  • Einen Sinn für Verantwortung und Effizienz – du liebst es, Systeme aufzubauen, die nachhaltig funktionieren

  • Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Automatisierungstools oder im Bereich Softwareentwicklung

Wir suchen strategische Vordenker mit Freude am Aufbau von Systemen, aber auch Organisationstalente, die strukturieren, anpacken und umsetzen.

title: Senior Sales Strategy & Operations Manager*in (w/m/d)
description:

Du bist das Gesicht von RevOps im Go-to-Market. 
Gemeinsam mit den Verantwortlichen aus unseren Neu- und Bestandskunden-Segmenten führst du FTAPI auf die nächste Wachstumsstufe. Die gesamte Journey liegt bewusst in einer Hand, deiner. 
So greifen Erkenntnisse aus Akquise und Expansion ineinander, statt in Silos zu leben.
